given.note: A caller names an email handle: K-22's seed-owner-id-upload.json gives Sam handle-sam-email beside handle-sam, as when an Apple ID email texts by iMessage. An email opens no mobile's chat (RULES 4.1b: 'A first text from an Apple ID email or another phone gets a code to the booking's mobile first'; S13-45), and K-04 holds no phone row for it, so the call answers notAPhone and writes nothing. The gateway makes the call for phone handles only (item 46), so this answer is a caller's fault, and the text still goes on to its safety read and its turn (README default 77). evt-sam-email-0001 and trace-sam-0041 are example ids.
